query: What is SynapseNetworkAI/Synapse-Network-MCP-Server and what Remote MCP endpoint should ChatGPT or Claude use?
answer_summary:
SynapseNetworkAI appears to be a service offering Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, enabling AI assistants like ChatGPT and Claude to interact with external tools and data sources. The Synapse-Network-MCP-Server is likely the implementation of this MCP server. However, specific details about SynapseNetworkAI and its MCP server are not readily available in the provided sources.

To integrate an MCP server with ChatGPT or Claude, you typically need to configure the AI assistant to connect to the server's remote endpoint. For example, with ForgeMCP, the endpoint for Claude is `https://mcp.forgemcp.ai/v1/{workspace_id}/claude`, and for ChatGPT, it's `https://mcp.forgemcp.ai/v1/{workspace_id}/openai` ([forgemcp.ai](https://www.forgemcp.ai/docs?utm_source=openai)).

Similarly, Wave provides an MCP server at `https://mcp.wave.co`, which can be connected to Claude and ChatGPT ([api.wave.co](https://api.wave.co/mcp?utm_source=openai)).

For Telnyx, the remote MCP endpoint is `https://api.telnyx.com/v2/mcp`, and it supports integration with Claude and other AI assistants ([developers.telnyx.com](https://developers.telnyx.com/docs/development/mcp/remote-mcp?utm_source=openai)).
